decision.case_state: Ticket NBL-001 (Flat 26, 46 Copperfield Walk) is at mp_time and on hold, waiting for the provider. Landlord approved the works on 3 Nov 2025 (event 022). Riverside Services (Freya) is doing the works, and the landlord pays the contractor directly. Completion is not confirmed. On 11 Dec a call (event 042) raised tree removal, which is outside the approved garden, weeds and hedge scope.

next_actions.action: Ask Riverside Services (Freya) in writing to confirm whether the garden, weeding and hedge work is complete, with date and photos; and to say whether tree removal is included, with a quote and a nesting-bird check.
Ask the landlord to approve or decline the tree removal, and to confirm the correct landlord contact.
Tell the tenant the works are with Riverside, that we are checking completion and any extra tree work, and that no completion date is confirmed yet.
Keep the job on hold until 2025-12-18, then review it.
Human to confirm the landlord contact and agent name, and decide on the tree removal scope.

decision.summary: The communal garden and hedge job is still open. The landlord approved it and Riverside Services is doing it, but completion is unconfirmed and tree removal has been raised as extra work. I asked the contractor for written completion and scope, asked the landlord to decide on the tree removal, updated the tenant, and escalated the landlord contact and agent name conflicts. The job stays on hold until 18 Dec.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: On hold for the provider (Riverside Services). The garden, weeding and hedge works were approved on 3 Nov and started around 20 Nov, but no completion is confirmed. Outstanding: written completion, a decision on the tree removal, and confirmation of the landlord contact.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Phone Freya at Riverside Services (existing contact from event 042) for completion and tree scope. Ask the landlord Rowan by approval request (APR-102) to approve or decline tree removal. Email the tenant Henry on the existing thread with an update and no promised date. Review on 18 Dec.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Yes. Management must confirm the landlord contact (Rowan or Felix Kendall) and the agent name (Northbridge Lettings or Juniper Homes), because the records conflict (ESC-104). The landlord must decide on tree removal, which is outside the approved scope and has no quote yet.
